So excited about this. We're rolling out a mechanism that protects Vercel customers even in a Binance-style attack, where your engineers get targeted with infostealer malware. With DBSC, renewing a session requires a key bound to your device, which means stolen cookies can't be practically re-used from remote Command & Control (C2) infrastructure. While this is a pretty major win, there's no silver bullet in security. Make sure your Vercel account has MFA enabled (both app-based TOTP and passkeys), your organization enables SAML / directory sync, your endpoints are protected, etc. (and stay paranoid!)
